description: JACoW's class for accelerator conference proceedings, jacow v2.7 (2022/02/02) from CTAN and MiKTeX. It is always two columns. a4paper is the option the class's own A4 template uses; it only sets geometry's paper size. Under XeTeX the class loads unicode-math and sets TeX Gyre Termes itself, and it needs nothing declared before \begin{document}, so the preamble is empty. General's lmodern, fontspec, font lines, amsmath and amssymb are left out (omitPreamble, as acmart-manuscript's): the class's XeTeX branch loads unicode-math (jacow.cls l.292-298), so amssymb stops at "\eth already defined", and General's Latin Modern would replace the class's TeX Gyre Termes and lose glyphs (batch 2 probe). With amssymb left out, thmtools' end-of-proof mark found \blacksquare undefined (135 branches, first batch 2 run); the last line gives it a square rule when unicode-math has not defined it by \begin{document}.
